people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
translations.bsb: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
translations.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
translations.asv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God will be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
